notes.title: Summer Update – Big Content Update v1.2
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey everyone![/h3]

[b]Exciting news![/b] The [b]Summer Update v1.2[/b] is live with [b]new weapons, a new map, an Easter Egg, new features, Summer Event camos, gameplay improvements, and bug fixes![/b]
To celebrate, we’re launching a [b]34% discount[/b] on the game — available for a limited time, so grab it while it lasts!

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8uAXRQU.jpeg[/img]

[h2][b]New Weapons[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*][b]GX-5 (SMG) – Primary[/b]
Unlocked by eliminating 3,500 zombies
Fire Rate: 765 RPM
Damage per bullet: 42
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2rWlcfp.png[/img]
[*][b]Plasma Shotgun – 40 Watt (Secondary)[/b]
Unlocked by eliminating 2,000 zombies
Fire Rate: 252 RPM
Damage per pellet: 60
Pellets per shot: 4
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xPb5J2t.png[/img]
[*][b]Golf Club (Melee)[/b]
Acquirable only in-game. Unlocked by completing the Easter Egg on Gravesend (then it spawns on the green) or can be purchased for 150,000 points on other maps.
Has double the range of the Knife and deals 50x damage.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sFdSTo6.png[/img]

[h2][b]NEW Map & Easter Egg (Camo Reward)[/b][/h2]

[b]Gravesend (New Map)[/b]
A luxurious old house with a private golf course, set in the forest, offering intense indoor and outdoor zombie battles in a unique and atmospheric environment!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gZLWRRe.jpeg[/img]

[b]Easter Egg[/b]
With the new map comes an [b]Easter Egg challenge[/b]. Completing it unlocks the [b]exclusive Gravesend Easter Egg Camo[/b] as a [b]reward[/b], and the [b]Golf Club[/b] will spawn for free on the green.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SyyQ6AB.png[/img]

[h2][b]New Features[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Doors[/b]
To add more diversity and strategy, doors have been added to the new [b]Gravesend map[/b] and the [b]Prison map[/b]. [b]Doors can be unlocked[/b] for[b] 1,500 points[/b] each.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fDiO9G1.jpeg[/img]

[*][b]Aimbot Power Up[/b]
A new Power Up that activates when you aim near a zombie. For 30 seconds, it automatically targets the heads of nearby zombies, and after eliminating one, it locks onto the next automatically.
[/list]

[h2][b]Summer Event[/b][/h2]

Celebrate the season with [b]exclusive Summer Event challenges[/b] and unlock a set of unique [b]animated camos[/b]! Complete the limited-time challenges to earn [b]6 exclusive rewards:[/b]

[list]
[*]Find all 7 hidden watermelons: Watermelon Camo (animated)
[*]Get 180 Fire Zombie eliminations: Root Camo Blue (animated)
[*]Get 15 Boss Zombie eliminations: Wave Camo (animated)
[*]Find all 7 hidden flip-flops: Palm Tree Camo (animated)
[*]Get 2,500 Zombie eliminations: Leopard Camo (animated)
[/list]

[b]Complete all challenges[/b] to unlock the [b]Master Reward[/b]:
[list]
[*]Summer Event Master Camo (animated)
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JbKLeuf.png[/img]

Make sure to complete all challenges before the event ends on September 4th! A dedicated Summer Event widget has been added to the main and pause menus for easy progress tracking.

[h2][b]Gameplay Improvements & Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the new weapons to the loot pool, firing range, and random weapon machines.
[*] [b]Added the Golf Club as a purchasable melee weapon (except on Gravesend) for 150,000 points.[/b]
[*] The [b]"Boom"[/b] Power Up [b]no longer kills Boss Zombies.[/b]
[*] [b]Reduced[/b] max. [b]number of simultaneous zombie audio[/b] instances from 9 to 7.
[*] Improved ORM materials on Prison walls and overall lighting quality.
[*] Added doors to the Prison and Gravesend maps.
[*] Adjusted ADS FOV curve from linear to S-curve for smoother aiming.
[*] Distance Field Shadows are now also active with medium shadow settings.
[*] Added a green outline to indicate when event challenges are completed.
[*] Added Steam and in-game leaderboards for the new Gravesend map.
[/list]

[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed some incorrect animations for VX-47 and Armax A-16 weapons.
[*] Fixed several spots on the Bridge, Airbase, and Prison maps where zombies could get stuck.
[*] Fixed a bug causing fire zombies to stop following players after being downed.
[*] Fixed a bug where the click sound played too often when opening the settings menu.
[/list]
[b]Enjoy the game![/b]

notes.title: Spring Event - Content Update v1.1
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey everyone![/h3]

[b]Thank you so much to everyone[/b] who has played [b]Deadzone Haunt[/b] so far! It's been an amazing first week, and I truly [b]appreciate[/b] all the [b]support[/b] and [b]feedback[/b]. To celebrate the release, the [b]first in-game event is now live[/b], with exciting [b]new content[/b] waiting for you to unlock!

Just as a [b]reminder[/b]: [b]Today[/b] is also the [b]last day[/b] of the [b]introduction offer[/b] — don’t miss out on the discounted price.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[h2][b]Spring Event (May 1st – June 6th)[/b][/h2]
Celebrate the season with the first in-game event — available from [b]May 1st to June 6th[/b]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/u1wCoKk.png[/img]
[h3][b]Complete a set of 4 limited-time challenges to earn 6 exclusive rewards:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[b][*] Eliminate 1,000 zombies: Tropic Camo (animated)
[*] Eliminate 8 boss zombies: Spring Camo (animated)
[*] Find all 6 hidden Easter eggs: Easter Camo (animated)
[*] Find all 6 hidden flowers: Mother’s Day Camo (animated)[/b][/list]
[h3][b]Complete all challenges to unlock the Master Reward:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[b][*] Spring Master Camo (animated)
[*] Spring Master Weapon Charm[/b][/list]
You must [b]complete[/b] all [b]challenges by June 6th[/b] — after that, the rewards will [b]no longer be obtainable![/b]

A [b]dedicated Spring Event[/b] widget has been added to both the [b]main menu[/b] and the [b]pause menu[/b], so you can easily [b]track your progress.[/b]

[h2][b]General[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed the player starting position on the Art House map.
[*] Adjusted locations of some ground pickups (weapons, ammo).
[*] Adjusted primary/secondary ammo spawn ratio from 50%/50% to 70%/30%.
[*] Moved the [b]"Use Custom Camos on Loadout Weapons"[/b] option higher in the settings menu for better accessibility.
[/list]
[h2][b]Leaderboard[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an incorrect name for the Winter Village Classic leaderboard on Steam.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Perked Up leaderboard widget loading the wrong game mode on activation.
[*] Improved leaderboard reliability: the in-game leaderboard should now load the correct categories on first startup or after tabbing out of the game more consistently.
[/list]
[h2][b]Aim Assist[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced the aim assist sphere radius around zombies from 89 cm to 75 cm.
[*] Aim assist strength on controller now scales from 22% at 0m to 100% at 4.5m and beyond, allowing for quicker turning when zombies are close.
[/list]
[h2][b]Audio[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Reduced[/b] max. [b]number of simultaneous zombie audio[/b] instances from 11 to 9.
[*] [b]Reduced[/b] overall [b]zombie audio volume by 12.5%[/b].
[*] The transition from 2D to 3D zombie audio now occurs at 1 meter instead of 2 meters.
[/list]
[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with aiming sensitivity during the transition from hip fire to ADS when using a controller.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented full-auto weapons from firing if you pressed the fire button too early after switching weapons or reloading.
[*] Fixed a recoil-related issue which helped resolve some stability issues.
[*] Fixed various spots where zombies could get stuck on the Prison, Bridge, and Bowling maps.
[/list]
[b]Enjoy the game![/b]

notes.title: Deadzone Haunt is Out Now!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey everyone![/h3]

[h3][b]Deadzone Haunt is out now![/b][/h3]
[b]Now it’s your turn — dive in and experience everything Deadzone Haunt has to offer![/b]

A [b]huge thank you[/b] to [b]each and every one[/b] of you for your support and feedback during development. Your input is always appreciated and helps me continue enhancing the experience with future updates.

You can [b]easily share your feedback[/b] or report bugs directly in-game — just head to Options > Feedback & Bug Report in the main menu.

For more [b]details[/b] on all the [b]game’s features[/b], check out the [b]Community posts[/b] from the past few days!

Now there’s only one thing left to say: [b]Enjoy the game![/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gmAhPgM.png[/img]

notes.title: Highlighted Features Overview (Daily Intel: T-1)
notes.notes:
[b]Hey everyone,[/b]

Only [b]1 day[/b] left until launch! Today, we're giving you a first look at several core features: [b]Minimap, Firing Range & Tutorial, Controller Support, Automatic Leaning, the Point System[/b], and the [b]Random Weapon Machine[/b].

[b]Automatic Leaning:[/b]
When aiming down sights and approaching cover like walls or vehicles, your character will automatically lean to the side.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qwgmaOo.png[/img]

[b]Minimap:[/b]
The minimap shows all key elements that help you dominate the zombies — including [b]ammo crates[/b] (800 points), all [b]perk machines[/b], the [b]Weapon Upgrade machine[/b], the [b]Random Weapon Machine[/b], and even all [b]active zombies[/b].
Below the minimap, you'll also see how many zombies are left in the current round.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jXFZAUO.png[/img]

[b]Controller Support:[/b]
Deadzone Haunt supports both controllers and mouse & keyboard. To deliver a true FPS experience on controller, we’ve implemented:

– Customizable Deadzones
– Optional Aim Assist (toggleable in settings)
– Optimized Aim Response Curves for smooth and responsive control
– Separate Sensitivity & ADS Sensitivity options
– Full Button Remapping (e.g. swap shoot from R2 to R1)

[b]Firing Range & Tutorial:[/b]
This is a dedicated map where you can test all weapons and upgrades against dummies to fine-tune your aim.
You can also start the tutorial here, which walks you through the key mechanics of the game.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hYoZTYg.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dom3dwh.png[/img]

[b]Point System:[/b]

– Normal Kill: 85 points
– Headshot Kill: 125 points
– Melee Kill: 160 points

[b]Random Weapon Machine:[/b]
Spin the Random Weapon Machine up to 10 times per game for 2,000 points per spin. Each spin gives you a random weapon — with a chance to receive an already-upgraded version.
See the drop chances below in the image:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tDb7o35.png[/img]

[b][i]Thanks for being part of this journey — we’re excited to launch tomorrow and can’t wait to hear what you think![/i][/b]

notes.title: Camo Mixing System Overview (Daily Intel: T-4)
notes.notes:
[b]Hey everyone,[/b]

Only [b]4 days[/b] left until launch! Today, we’re giving you a first look at the [b]Camo Mixing System[/b] in Deadzone Haunt.

You can experiment with the [b]Camo Mixing Tool[/b] at any time, but you’ll only be able to [b]equip your creations[/b] once you’ve unlocked the [b]Zekop Mastery Camo[/b].
(For more on how to unlock it, check out the [b]Camo Overview[/b] post from a few days ago.)

This overview is all about how the system works — and how it gives you access to over [b]10.78 million unique camo combinations[/b] — [i]one of the most in-depth camo customization systems in any FPS game[/i].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/M8IpQEr.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/IHDytVP.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/p5n7QEs.gif[/img]

With the Camo Mixing Tool, you can combine [b]three different camos[/b] — or even stack the same one multiple times.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bFN6VNv.png[/img]

[b]Mixing Pattern:[/b]
The [b]Mixing Pattern[/b] defines how your three chosen camos blend together.
– Red = Camo 1
– Green = Camo 2
– Blue = Camo 3

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4MDIgNE.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZY8Ubjq.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/o0hUJ9c.png[/img]

[b]Pattern Tiling:[/b]
Pattern Tiling determines how often your pattern repeats across the weapon’s surface.
Set anywhere from [b]1 to 12[/b] for different results.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DirCE5O.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jG8u66k.png[/img]

[b]Emissive Boost:[/b]
This controls how brightly your camo glows.
A lower value gives it a more metallic look, while a high value makes your weapon shine intensely.
Adjustable from [b]0 to 12[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WbqRcKa.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Yrs9q58.png[/img]

[b]Configuration Slots:[/b]
You can save up to [b]5 camo configurations[/b] for quick access.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WEw0i6g.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KDbxDOn.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WaM82zt.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LdbjqlC.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BPcPDRA.png[/img]

Once you've built your custom camos, you can [b]apply them to your loadout weapons[/b] — just like selecting any other camo.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OdaF0cA.png[/img]

[b][i]More intel coming tomorrow...[/i][/b]

notes.title: Game Mode Overview (Daily Intel: T-5)
notes.notes:
[b]Hey everyone,[/b]

Only [b]5 days[/b] left until launch! Today, we’re giving you a first look at the [b]Game Modes[/b] that will be available on day one.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NMBxcMM.png[/img]

[b]Classic:[/b]
The default mode — survive as many rounds as you can. No limits.

[b]10 Rounds:[/b]
Same rules as Classic, but the game ends after 10 rounds. Perfect for short sessions, practice, or speedrunning.

[b]Battle Royale:[/b]
As the game starts, a gas zone begins shrinking for 10 minutes.
After that, it stops shrinking but starts [b]moving every 30 seconds for 60 seconds[/b].
Inside the gas, you take [b]10 damage per second[/b]. Use [b]Stims[/b] to survive longer — but you’ll have to [b]time them right[/b] to stay alive.
The [b]Tactical & Lethal Perk[/b] is your best friend in this mode.
(Infinite rounds)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Cxa7c7r.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gvOVe9d.png[/img]

[b]Extreme:[/b]
Zombies move [b]150% faster[/b] and have [b]50% more health[/b].
Only for the brave.
(Infinite rounds)

[b]Easy:[/b]
Zombies move [b]25% slower[/b] and have [b]25% less health[/b]. — great for beginners or relaxed runs.
(Infinite rounds)

[b]Perked Up:[/b]
Same as Classic, but you start with [b]every Perk equipped[/b] from the beginning.
(Infinite rounds)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uSWI2c1.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ewY8XQ4.png[/img]


[b][i]More intel coming tomorrow...[/i][/b]

notes.title: Camo Overview (Daily Intel: T-6)
notes.notes:
[b]Hey everyone,[/b]

Only [b]6 days[/b] left until launch! Today, we’re giving you a first look at how the [b]Camo System[/b] works.

[b]Sidenote:[/b] In the [b]Settings[/b] under [b]Video & Interface[/b], you can enable a feature that keeps your [b]custom camo skins[/b] on Loadout Weapons — even after upgrading them. Otherwise, upgraded weapons will use their default upgrade camo.

[b]Weapon-Specific Camos:[/b]
Every weapon in the game has [b]3 unique weapon specific camos[/b] you can unlock by completing these challenges:
– 500 Kills
– 250 Headshots
– 250 Upgraded Weapon Kills

[img]https://i.imgur.com/h1qYf09.png[/img]

Once unlocked, you can use any of these camos on [b]any other weapon[/b].

[b]Mastery Camos:[/b]

[b]Gold:[/b] Unlock all 3 weapon-specific camos for one weapon to earn its [b]Gold Camo[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DfKj8XQ.png[/img]

[b]Melodic:[/b] Unlock Gold on all 7 base weapons to gain access to the [b]Melodic Camo[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3cat0xV.png[/img]

[b]Zekop:[/b] Equip the Melodic Camo and get [b]1,000 kills with every weapon[/b] to unlock the ultimate [b]Mastery Camo[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/NPH2wxj.png[/img]

[b]Camo Mixing:[/b]
You can experiment with the [b]Camo Mixing Tool[/b] at any time — but you’ll only be able to equip your custom creations once you’ve unlocked the [b]Zekop Camo[/b].

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZARHoki.png[/img]

[b][i]More intel coming tomorrow...[/i][/b]

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

The launch is just around the corner - Deadzone Haunt will be available on Steam on [b]April 24, 2025[/b]! We’ve been working hard to improve the game since the demo. Our goal will always be to deliver smooth gameplay, great performance, and a visually appealing experience.

Don’t forget to save the date—[b]April 24th[/b]! More updates will be coming soon. Thanks for being part of this journey!

notes.title: The Demo Has Ended – Thank You for Your Support!
notes.notes:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

The [b]demo[/b] is now over, and we want to thank you all for playing and sharing your [b]feedback[/b] through the in-game tool and here in the Steam Community Group!

We’re excited to share that nearly [b]1,000 unique players[/b] took part in the demo over the past [b]two and a half weeks[/b], and the in-game feedback tool was used 60 times to provide us with helpful feedback. Your input has been [b]incredibly valuable[/b], and we've already made [b]some improvements based[/b] on your suggestions. We're continuing to work on making the game even better.

[b]Thanks again for your support[/b], and stay tuned for [b]more updates![/b]

notes.title: Update 0.005b (Demo)
notes.notes:
[b]Movement & Mechanics Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Reworked sliding and stim mechanics[/b] to make movement feel more fluid:

[list]
[*] [b]Sliding and stims[/b] are now [b]speed-based[/b] instead of force-based.
[*] Added a sliding speed curve for a more [b]natural[/b] and realistic slide experience.
[*] Updated braking deceleration while sliding for smoother transitions.
[*] This rework also [b]fixes an exploit[/b] where spamming slide and jump could lead to unintended speed boosts. [b]Slide canceling remains possible.[/b]
[*] [b]Stims[/b] now provide a [b]40% speed boost to overall movement speed[/b] for [b]3 seconds.[/b]
[*] Increased HUD animation brightness while using a stim to better reflect its effect.
[*] Increased stim activation sound volume by 30% for better audio feedback.
[/list]
[/list]
[b]UI & Quality of Life Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] The Random Weapon Machine now displays the probabilities of each weapon upgrade tier above the device.
[*] [b]Added a new movement setting: "Slide to Crouch"[/b]
[list]
[*] When disabled (default), players will automatically stand up after sliding instead of staying crouched.
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Weapon Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Knife Movement Buff:[/b]
[list]
[*] Tactical Sprint Speed increased from 780 cm/s to 840 cm/s.
[*] Sprint Speed increased from 700 cm/s to 750 cm/s.
[/list]
[*] [b]VX-9[/b] Fire Rate reduced from 900 RPM to 880 RPM.
[*] Adjusted hand sway parameters.
[*] Added [b]individual recoil patterns[/b] and visual recoil for every weapon.
[/list]
[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Brightness of the Nuke Flash reduced by 40%.
[*] The Nuke Power-Up now grants 400 points upon activation.
[*] [b]ADS Field of View adjusted[/b] from [b]90 to 82.5[/b] (Non-ADS remains at 110).
[/list]
[b]Bug Fix[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where single-fire weapons did not properly respect their intended fire rate.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.002b (Demo)
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who has already tried out the Deadzone Haunt demo and used the in-game feedback function. Based on this, the first update has been released, which has significantly improved looting and interacting with items.

Quality of Life Improvements:
[list]
[*] Significant [b]improvements when looting weapons and interacting with perk machines.[/b]
[list]
[*] Now the direction in which you are looking is prioritized instead of the operator overlap when interacting
[*] The overlap radius of the individual objects has also been adjusted
[/list]
[*] When interacting with [b]perk machines[/b], a [b]description[/b] of the perk is now displayed to make it easier to understand.
[/list]

General:
[list]
[*] Operator audio volume has been reduced by 25%
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the last zombies in rounds where more than 15 zombies were alive would sometimes have no audio active.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Available Until March 7, 2025 – Try It Now!
notes.notes:
The [b]Demo[/b] for [b]Deadzone Haunt[/b] is now live on Steam. Play it until [b]March 7, 2025[/b].

We appreciate your feedback. Please use the [b]in-game feedback[/b] feature to share your thoughts and [b]unlock an extra weapon[/b] in the demo.

Thank you for playing!
